title: kate-lsp: convert positions between offsets and LSP positions
summary: PositionEncoding names UTF-8 or UTF-16 columns. to_lsp turns a scalar offset in a rope into a line and a character count in that encoding. from_lsp does the reverse and clamps a line or a character past the end. The server negotiates the encoding at initialize.

lane.reason: Either lane may code this packet. It is one file, one behavior, and one test, and the rule text in this packet is the oracle. The first idle lane takes it.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Use rope char_to_line, line_to_char, and the line slice chars; count len_utf8 or len_utf16 per scalar before the offset for to_lsp; walk the line for from_lsp until the count reaches character. The line break scalar is not part of the line. The test utf16_counts_an_emoji_as_two uses the rope a😀b\nc and asserts to_lsp of Offset(2) is line 0 character 3 in Utf16 and character 5 in Utf8, from_lsp of line 0 character 3 Utf16 is Offset(2), from_lsp of line 0 character 99 is Offset(3), and from_lsp of line 9 character 0 is the start of the last line. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: encoding::tests::utf16_counts_an_emoji_as_two
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because the functions do not exist. After the change an emoji counts two UTF-16 units and four UTF-8 bytes and out-of-range positions clamp.
